Upper 25–30 percent should be visually quiet so the separately typeset headline can be placed there; stage the actual objects and people prominently in the remaining area. The scene must carry the story; never substitute generic abstract cards, charts, floating app UI, or an anonymous cashier portrait. Cobalt-blue details connect the brand while other scene colors remain natural. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, readable receipts, signage, A/B/C graphics, infographic panels, price typography, or actual app screenshots. Unbranded screens and tags remain blank. Fictional illustrative art, not a real merchant photo or testimonial.
Style: Premium art-directed photographic still life, tactile objects and appetizing products, clear directional lighting, deliberate material detail and composition.
Color direction: cobalt, pale pink, brass.
Specific scene: Precise studio still life of one beautifully boxed bakery slice, a blank pink discount tag, a small brass balance scale with a few coins on one side and tiny ingredient portions on the other. Focus on the tangible trade-off when price is cut. Three-quarter close view, hard clean shadows, premium product photography, no quantities or numerals.
